---
title: "JQI_NationalEconViews"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# JQI and Views of the National Economy
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Setup
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)
library(car)

# Load GSS job-quality data
jqi_gss <- readRDS(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "gss_job_quality_primary_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Construct national-economy outcome
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# IMPORTANT:
# Replace `national_economy_raw` below with the actual GSS
# variable you are using if it has a different name.
#
# The coding should be:
#   higher values = more negative views of the national economy
#
# If you have already constructed `national_economy`, skip
# the recoding step and simply use that variable below.

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Construct national-economy outcome
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jqi_econ <- jqi_gss %>%
  mutate(
    national_economy = case_when(
      as.numeric(econstat) %in% 1:5 ~
        as.numeric(econstat),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(national_economy),
    !is.na(compensation),
    !is.na(benefits),
    !is.na(earnings_stability)
  )

# Check coding
table(
  jqi_econ$national_economy,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

# Check years
sort(unique(jqi_econ$year))

# Check industries
sort(unique(jqi_econ$industry_common))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Descriptive statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jqi_econ %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_national_economy = mean(
      national_economy,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sd_national_economy = sd(
      national_economy,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_compensation = mean(
      compensation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_benefits = mean(
      benefits,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_earnings_stability = mean(
      earnings_stability,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. POOLED SEPARATE COMPONENT MODELS
# ============================================================

# Compensation
m_econ_compensation <- lm(
  national_economy ~ compensation,
  data = jqi_econ
)

summary(m_econ_compensation)


# Benefits
m_econ_benefits <- lm(
  national_economy ~ benefits,
  data = jqi_econ
)

summary(m_econ_benefits)


# Earnings stability
m_econ_earnings <- lm(
  national_economy ~ earnings_stability,
  data = jqi_econ
)

summary(m_econ_earnings)


# Compact coefficient table
econ_separate_models <- bind_rows(
  tidy(m_econ_compensation) %>%
    filter(term == "compensation") %>%
    mutate(component = "Compensation"),

  tidy(m_econ_benefits) %>%
    filter(term == "benefits") %>%
    mutate(component = "Benefits"),

  tidy(m_econ_earnings) %>%
    filter(term == "earnings_stability") %>%
    mutate(component = "Earnings stability")
) %>%
  select(
    component,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value
  )

econ_separate_models


# ============================================================
# 4. POOLED JOINT COMPONENT MODEL
# ============================================================

m_econ_components <- lm(
  national_economy ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability,
  data = jqi_econ
)

summary(m_econ_components)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Multicollinearity
# ------------------------------------------------------------

vif(m_econ_components)


# ============================================================
# 6. YEAR-SPECIFIC JOINT MODELS
# ============================================================

yearly_econ_models <- jqi_econ %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  group_modify(~ {

    model <- lm(
      national_economy ~
        compensation +
        benefits +
        earnings_stability,
      data = .x
    )

    tidy(model) %>%
      filter(
        term %in% c(
          "compensation",
          "benefits",
          "earnings_stability"
        )
      )

  }) %>%
  ungroup()

yearly_econ_models


# Cleaner presentation
yearly_econ_models %>%
  select(
    year,
    term,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value
  )
?econstat

# ============================================================
# 7. FORMAL TEST OF TEMPORAL HETEROGENEITY
# ============================================================

m_econ_component_year <- lm(
  national_economy ~
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = jqi_econ
)

summary(m_econ_component_year)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Joint test: compensation × year
# ------------------------------------------------------------

linearHypothesis(
  m_econ_component_year,
  grep(
    "^compensation:factor\\(year\\)",
    names(coef(m_econ_component_year)),
    value = TRUE
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Joint test: benefits × year
# ------------------------------------------------------------

linearHypothesis(
  m_econ_component_year,
  grep(
    "^benefits:factor\\(year\\)",
    names(coef(m_econ_component_year)),
    value = TRUE
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Joint test: earnings stability × year
# ------------------------------------------------------------

linearHypothesis(
  m_econ_component_year,
  grep(
    "^earnings_stability:factor\\(year\\)",
    names(coef(m_econ_component_year)),
    value = TRUE
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 8. OPTIONAL: SAVE YEAR-SPECIFIC RESULTS
# ============================================================

write_csv(
  yearly_econ_models,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_NationalEconomy_YearSpecific_Results.csv"
  )
)
```
